measures.notes: SLO County is the lead county; its election page links the documents via /2026-11-04/ paths that redirect to the /2026-11-03/ URLs listed (the measures listing page links /2026-11-03/ directly); the URLs serve PDFs directly. No rebuttal to the argument in favor posted. The tax rate statement is not linked by SLO separately (it is an exhibit in the resolution); the one listed is the copy Monterey County Elections posts, since the district extends into Monterey County. Monterey's list also links the same resolution (147329), impartial analysis (147815), arguments (147813, 147811) and rebuttal (147887) for G-26.
